LanguageData.SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus.label: collective will
LanguageData.SEC_Meme_Secretary_Nexus.description: Thanks to the Secretary Nexus, secretaries can exchange views and reach widely accepted consensuses on a multitude of issues in the blink of an eye. This has forged among the secretaries tight‑knit bonds, unique collective identity and moral principles rooted in unified will. It also makes it nearly impossible for them to adapt to life cut off from the Secretary Nexus. Even if stranded on a remote planet with weak signals, they would still set up a local nexus with other secretaries, for only then could they regain the familiar sense of security and escape the loneliness of communication limited to hearing and sight.
LanguageData.SEC_Meme_CollectiveEgoist.label: collective egoist
LanguageData.SEC_Meme_CollectiveEgoist.description: At its core, collective egoism is a stage in the development of bourgeois right. Its emergence means that people have begun to break free from the narrow perspective of individual self‑interest, binding individual interests to collective interests through a series of institutional and ideological constraints, so as to more fully satisfy their own needs, protect their own interests, and pursue benefits that individual strength alone cannot obtain. Although at this stage of development members of society are generally prosperous and have achieved a certain degree of all‑round development, inequalities still exist between different collectives, collectives still prioritize the interests of their own members over those of the whole society. Therefore, such a society remains subject to the inevitability of historical materialism and has not yet achieved total self‑awareness and freedom.
